data.cultural_impact: The name 'Shokufa' signifies elegance, charm, and beauty, evoking the imagery of the lush grape vineyards prevalent in various Islamic lands, thereby connecting the individual to the rich heritage and traditions of the Islamic world. The name also embodies the idea of abundance, as grapes represent a symbol of prosperity and good fortune. Furthermore, the name adds a sense of sophistication and refinement, reminding one of the merits of enjoying the simple pleasures in life.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name 'Shokufa' lies in its connection to the divine concept of 'Rahmaniyyah' or God's Mercy. In Islamic theology, grapes are believed to have been created from a drop of sweat that fell from the mouth of Prophet Adam while he was prostrating in repentance, signifying God's boundless compassion and forgiveness. The name Shokufa, therefore, serves as a constant reminder of the boundless love and forgiveness bestowed upon humans by the Almighty, surah iQasais verses 35-36, invoking in us a spirit of humility, gratitude, and reverence.
